case_title: BENTON, WILLIAM K vs. LASH, LORELEI et al

docket_entries.description: CAUSE CALLED FOR COURT TRIAL. PL. PRESENT & IN PRO PER. DEF PRESENT W/DAVID WILLIAMSON AS COUNSEL. REPORTER WAS JOHN LEWIS. CASE SETTLED BY STIPULATION W/JUDGMENT FOR PL. - RESTITUTION OF PREMISES AT 1080 BUSH ST, #101. WRIT MAY ISSUE IMMEDIATELY, BUT EVICTION STAYED TO 8-15-93, NOON. $2,300 RENT & DAMAGES. IF DEFS. MOVE OUT BY 8-15-93, DEFS' ATTY MAY PETITION THE COURT W/PROPER NOTICE TO PL, TO SET ASIDE JUDMENT & DISMISS W/PREJUDICE. DEFS. TO LEAVE PREMISES IN BROOM CLEAN CONDITION & RETURN KEYS TO RESIDENT MANAGER. SECURITY DEPOSIT IS FORFEITED & TO BE CREDITED TOWARD RENT & DAMAGES OWED. ALL PARTIES ARE ENJOINED FROM HARASSING THE OTHER SIDE. DEFS' ATTY. TO PREPARE JUDGMENT.
